comments_data.body: Hello, **Note:**  I'm currently running a Windows operating system on my computer. I've managed to download the node_sqlite3.node file tailored for the Windows 64-bit (win64) platform successfully. I've also attempted to install it on Linux and macOS. Hello Lilit - we certainly aren't using those large json files in Serge anymore. You have removed the code that used them.

review_comments_data.body:
Hello @lilitkarapetyan :-)

In our current test implementation we're getting map tiles from the Internet. But, it's almost certain that future wargames will require locally hosted tiles - so we should keep the /tiles route, please.

issues.title: Verify executable generator
issues.body:
For the next wargame we're going to need to be able to deploy Serge as an executable.

We should verify the executable generator runs properly (`yarn pkg-build`), and in particular check the MS-Windows executable works.

Note: it currently runs to completion, but the `macos` executable certainly fails:
```
./executable-macos 
running client with local server
(You can give the second parameter as the remote server URL)
```
